cases.prompt: A person crawls forward slowly on their hands and knees.
A person lies on their back on the floor, rolls onto their side and pushes up to stand.

scope: Functional integration probe for newly selectable position/rotation conditioning channels. Original reference poses are measured development failures, not clean corrective targets. These four clips do not replace the five-seed geometry benchmark, validate contact correction, define an action whitelist or approve motion quality. No changed reference pose, model weights, postprocessing, training, held-out data or release criteria.
